row.body: Personal note — Wednesday before rain: wash off the gray foam left by the feed additive trial crew. my brother started coughing, and I had not yet heard that a deputy taped off the road.
row.title: Wednesday before rain — gray foam

sidecar.gloss: A personal trace connects a farm trial to symptoms before a later restriction.
sidecar.rival_reading: Emergency workers could have picked up the same gray foam while responding near a field; this personal trace does not prove the trial caused the emergency.
